Team —

We have a small set of private-fleet CVEs and a behavioral regression that surfaced in Acme Health's staging cluster during the compatibility sweep last night. Attached is a proposed pinlist export with an initial risk score column (pinlist_20250701.csv). I want to get alignment on:

1) Which pin candidates we must push as a hotpatch (no fork) vs. which can be scheduled into the July maintenance cadence.
2) The maintenance window we'd use for Acme (they asked for a narrow window).
3) Explicit rollback/shelving triggers so Acme's SRE team can sign off.

Proposed plan summary:
- Hotpatch window: 2025-07-06 02:00–04:00 UTC (low-customer-traffic window)
- Owners: ops (Acme) + Redwood on-call for rollout and monitoring
- Rollback: immediate version-shelving + KV cache restore to snapshot T-10m if we see error rate > 3x baseline for 5 minutes

Please review the pinlist and the short diff (I'll circulate the hotfix patch after we triage). Need approvals by EOD Friday (2025-07-04) to keep the July 6 window. If you think any item should be escalated out of band, flag it in your reply.

Thanks,
David

--

> I did a quick scan of the CSV — good work surfacing the risk column.

Quick technical notes after a local dry-run of the hotfix candidate (see attached hotfix-diff-v2.patch):

- The high-risk items in the CSV map to two types: (A) runtime kernel fixes that require a short restart of the model server process, and (B) KV-cache eviction bugfixes that are in-path for long-lived sessions.
- For A-type fixes: we can do a rolling restart per AZ; impact window will be ~3–5 minutes per node. No DB migrations.
- For B-type fixes: recommended approach is to deploy behind a canary weight (20%) for the first 30 minutes with KV snapshot + prewarm flow enabled. If error rate stays <1.5x baseline, ramp to 60% then full.

Rollback mechanics I propose:
1) Shelve the new image version in the orchestration control plane (fast revert).
2) Trigger KV-cache snapshot restore to T-10m (where we keep a ring of 6 snapshots).
3) If automatic restore fails or telemetry indicates state mismatch, execute cross-region failover to standby cluster and open bridge for escalation.

I'll add a short runbook with exact CLI commands to the Drive folder. We should also capture a simple gating matrix (pass/fail thresholds) so Security can accept the hotpatch hazard.

Karthik
